Which statement about mass is correct?
A
A mass of 10kg weighs 1N near the Earth’s surface.
B
Mass is a gravitational force.
C
Mass increases when the gravitational field strength increases.
D
The greater the mass of a body, the more it resists a change in its motion.

options.label: A
options.text: A mass of 10kg weighs 1N near the Earth’s surface.

options.label: C
options.text: Mass increases when the gravitational field strength increases.

options.label: D
options.text: The greater the mass of a body, the more it resists a change in its motion.
